svg.title: World Physical Map
svg.text: major mountain ranges ▲, rivers ~, and deserts (equirectangular)
Highest: Mt. Everest 8,849 m (Himalayas). Longest river: the Nile (~6,650 km) / Amazon (largest by volume).
Largest desert: the Sahara (~9.2M km²). Mountain ranges form mainly at tectonic plate boundaries.
